rationale: The replication correctly reproduces the Chern-Simons ME quantum (24.34 vs 24.3 ps/m, <0.2% error) and demonstrates the orbital/Berry-phase methodology including the itinerant circulation operator. However, the paper's headline claim—the absolute transverse ME response α⊥=1.04 ps/m—was not reproduced because it is ~98% spin-derived and requires full SOC DFT+U with phonons and spin susceptibility calculations. The replicators honestly scoped this limitation rather than fabricating results. Coverage is low because the main quantitative result was not attempted; agreement is high for the methodological components that were tested.
